learning_outcomes.text: Students will gain knowledge about the properties of wastes and their constituent compounds.
Students will gain skills in learning chemical reactions and determining parameters.
Students will also learn about treatment methods.
Students will learn the concept of having environmental awareness.
Students will also gain knowledge about sampling, storage, and preparation for analysis.

syllabus_topics: General characteristics and classification of wastes
Industrial wastes and natural resource wastes
Environmental effects of wastes and water pollution mechanism
Treatment of industrial wastewaters with new methods
